verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a full API reference (every endpoint has a generated command, OpenAPI 3.1 schema) and subscription creation/assignment plus upgrade/downgrade flows are documented via API, supporting most of the lifecycle without a dashboard. However, no evidence explicitly documents 'pause' or 'cancel subscription' API endpoints — only assign/upgrade/downgrade are cited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or endpoint reference for pausing and cancelling subscriptions via API, independent hands-on confirmation of these specific operations.
